ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and limb (b) fails outright. POL-NS-02 defines arrival as at least 3 consecutive position fixes inside the arrival radius of the pickup pin, for this trip 120 m because trip_record records pickup_zone_class LARGE_VENUE. The driver's trace contains 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and 0 qualifying fix count, so the driver was never inside that radius at any point in the 15 minutes before he cancelled at 13:10:30. On POL-NS-02's own terms the driver never arrived, limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The distance is not marginal or borderline. Every one of the driver's 34 fixes sits 219.77 m from the pickup pin (min 219.77 m, max 219.77 m, mean 219.77 m) at a reported speed of 0.0 km/h, which is roughly 100 m outside the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for LARGE_VENUE shopping-mall pickup zones such as this one. There is no reading of the trace on which the driver was at the pickup pin, and the GPS measurement is complete (coverage_pct 100.0).

Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 fails independently of limb (b). The driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds, with 0 qualifying fixes and dwell_start_offset_sec null, against the 300-second minimum dwell that POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06 fix for LARGE_VENUE. The driver did not hold position inside the geofence for any part of the waiting period the fee is supposed to purchase, so the dwell condition never even began to run.

POL-NS-06 then applies on its own terms: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against a 300-second minimum for this zone class, a shortfall of 300 seconds computed on the longest_run_sec basis. POL-NS-06 is strict: where the corrected dwell is shorter than the POL-NS-01 minimum the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The fare_breakdown line to be refunded is the 4.00 SGD cancellation_fee that was charged at 13:10:32.

The driver cannot rescue the shortfall through POL-NS-06 limb (i), which is the only route to accumulating dwell across intervals and requires a present, populated traffic_advisory of an admissible type covering this pickup road and waiting window. The trace shows 0 in-geofence intervals and 0 runs for limb (i) to sum in the first place, and the only advisory on file, EV-ADVIS-09105-01, is MISSING with no payload and weight_multiplier 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable on both counts. I disclose that artifact's impairment: it is tagged MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and carries no weight; I rely on its absence, which POL-GEN-02 makes citable, and not on any content.

This is precisely the wrong-entrance case POL-NS-03 governs rather than a no-show. The driver's trace shows him stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling: 34 fixes spanning 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, about 330 seconds, all at 219.77 m from trip_record.pickup and all at 0.0 km/h. The 400 m ceiling is the whole test and is measured from the pickup coordinates alone, so no venue-identity inference is needed. The driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

On fault, POL-NS-03 limb (i) puts the loss on the driver and extinguishes his compensation. The rider named the sub-location in the chat: at 13:05:05, 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign.', and again at 13:06:35, 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' The driver answered at 13:06:00 that he was 'waiting at the mall taxi stand' and, on his own trace, never moved from a fixed point 219.77 m away before cancelling at 13:10:30. Where the rider stated the correct entrance or tower and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation.

Independently of POL-NS-03, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider. Limb (a): the rider's 13:06:35 message is locating and coordinating content — it identifies the correct entrance and asks the driver to come to Tower B. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message, indeed posted nothing at all between 13:06:00 and his 13:10:30 cancellation, a silence of 235 seconds spanning the whole remaining wait, and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no voice call defeats the clause either.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively satisfied, not undecidable. The rider track is available and all 16 rider fixes qualify: each is about 25.01 m from the pin (min 25.01 m, max 25.01 m, mean 25.01 m) and stationary at 0.0 km/h, so the rider's device sat inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider_presence_radius_m for 100 per cent of qualifying fixes across the waiting window. The rider was at the pin, messaging, the entire time the driver held 219.77 m away.

Nothing in this bundle is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08, so the distance figures are safe to decide on. The driver track holds 34 fixes at a 10-second sample interval with an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0, far above the 6-fix floor and with no 120-second gap; the trip_record arrived event at 13:05:20 lands on a fix timestamp, so there is no clock skew even approaching 90 seconds; the chat log holds 4 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 4, with no msg_id gap; and the 4.00 SGD cancellation_fee equals the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), so there is no defect under limb (d).

POL-NS-07 compensates the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (b) fails on the trace and limb (c) fails on the zero-second dwell, and POL-NS-03 displaces the fee in any event, so the 3.20 SGD driver compensation floor does not arise and no part of the rider's fee should fund a driver payment.

Escalation under POL-NS-09 is not open on this record and should not be used to hold the fee instead of refunding it. The deciding artifacts all carry weight 1.0 so the confidence floor in limb (a) is not engaged; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; limb (c) does not fire because rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; and limb (d) does not fire because rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The case can and should be decided on the merits, and I note that a held fee is not a rider win.

On the remedy: the rider is the filing party, and fare_breakdown shows the 4.00 SGD cancellation fee with payment_status CHARGED, total_charged 4.00 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider presently carries the whole disputed amount. Under POL-GEN-03 a rider win is a ruling that leaves the rider not carrying that charge, and the whole contested amount is contested here — 4.00 SGD — so the correct outcome is FULL_REFUND of 4.00 SGD, with no split, since no limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged and no admissible artifacts conflict.

The driver's own trace shows a genuine, unbroken wait: 34 fixes from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30, every one recording 0.0 km/h and a constant 219.8 m from the pin, with trace_distance_km of 0.00 — a stationary hold of 330 seconds, corroborated by trip_record.wait_time_min of 5.2. That hold is longer than the 300-second minimum dwell for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, so the defect in this case is one of location only, not of impatience: this was a full-timer wait at the venue, not a drive-by cancellation or a driver who took another job and came back.

POL-NS-05's false-arrival branch is not engaged and no false-arrival record is warranted against this driver. The trace places him stationary 219.8 m from the pin — inside the clause's own 300 m carve-out — with no motion at or above 15 km/h, and POL-NS-05 expressly states that a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius is not caught by it and is decided under POL-NS-03. The 13:05:20 'arrived' marker accordingly cannot generate the POL-NS-05(ii) referral; the case belongs in POL-NS-03 as a wrong-entrance dispute.

The driver did not abandon the rider in the chat, so the rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04. The rider's locating message ('I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign') was sent at 13:05:05 and the driver posted his own position ('I am waiting at the mall taxi stand') at 13:06:00 — 55 seconds later, well inside the 120-second window — so limb (b) of POL-NS-04 is not satisfied, no in-app call was required (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), and the clause confirms that any residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03 rather than as a driver-side coordination failure.

The driver does not resist the refund of the SGD 4.00 fee, and this concession is made on his own evidence. His trace never places him inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius — minimum distance 219.8 m, qualifying_fix_count 0, longest qualifying run 0.0 seconds — so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is not met, the fee is not chargeable under that clause, and POL-NS-03 refunds it to the rider in full. The ledger amount (cancellation_fee 4.00, reconciling with the LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the RYDE_X tier fee under the POL-NS-01 resolution rule) is not disputed, and no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises.

On fault allocation under POL-NS-03 the driver accepts limb (i) and claims nothing under limb (ii). The rider named the sub-location in the chat — 'Tower B ride-hail pickup' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35 — and the driver's own statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance and did not move to Tower B before cancelling at 13:10:30. The mislocation is therefore attributed to the driver rather than to pin ambiguity, notwithstanding the 3 registered pickup points recorded for this venue, and no compensation or pin-ambiguity goodwill is sought.

No adverse inference about the driver's conduct may be built on his record. Under POL-GEN-01 the lifetime counter driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is context only and may not be substituted for the field the no-show clauses read; the citable field is driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d, which stands at 1 against 120 completed trips in 30 days — far below POL-NS-07's anti-farming threshold of 4 terminations and an 8 percent rate — so no charge-farming pattern can be found on this record.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: the disputed SGD 4.00 no-show fee is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable. This turns on location, not on how long the driver waited.

ARRIVAL AND DWELL. The pickup is a LARGE_VENUE zone ('NEX Serangoon, Tower B ride-hail pickup'), so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m. The driver's own GPS trace places all 34 of his fixes (13:05:00 to 13:10:30, every one at 0.0 km/h) at 219.8 m from the pin — zero qualifying in-geofence fixes, longest in-geofence run 0.0 s. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01. Because the driver was nonetheless stationary for the required 300-second dwell (about 330 s of continuous fixes) at a point outside the 120 m radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling POL-NS-03 sets, POL-NS-03 governs and refunds the fee in full. POL-NS-06 points the same way (0 s of in-geofence dwell against a 300 s minimum), and its limb (i) accumulation route is unavailable: there are no intervals to sum, and the only advisory on file (EV-ADVIS-09105-01) is MISSING with weight 0.0 — I rely on that absence, which POL-GEN-02 makes citable, not on any content. The SGD 4.00 charge itself is correct: it is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises.

WHO BEARS THE LOSS. The chat log decides this. The rider wrote at 13:05:05 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' and again at 13:06:35 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' The driver replied at 13:06:00 that he was at 'the mall taxi stand', and his own statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance and did not move to Tower B before cancelling. Under POL-NS-03 limb (i) the mislocation is attributed to the driver and his compensation is extinguished. The 3 registered pickup points do not convert this into pin ambiguity, because the rider did name the sub-location, so no POL-NS-03(ii) goodwill arises.

MATTERS RAISED BY THE DRIVER. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the driver was stationary within the clause's own 300 m carve-out and below 15 km/h, so the 'arrived' marker is not a false arrival and no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is made — the case falls to POL-NS-03 exactly as that clause directs. The driver's concession that the fee should be refunded is accepted. His point that driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 is correct; the anti-farming check reads no_show_terminations_30d (1) against completed_trips_30d (120), far below POL-NS-07's thresholds, so no charge-farming pattern is found and no adverse inference is drawn from his record. POL-NS-07 compensation does not arise in any event, because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied and POL-NS-03 displaces it.

MATTERS RAISED BY THE RIDER. POL-NS-04 is contested: the driver did reply within 120 seconds of the rider's first locating message, though not of the second. The point is academic — whether or not POL-NS-04 additionally exonerates the rider, POL-NS-03 independently produces the same result: full refund, no driver compensation. The rider's rider-presence showing (all 16 fixes ~25 m from the pin, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius) is noted but adds nothing the location finding does not already give.

INTEGRITY AND ESCALATION. No artifact is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08: no clock skew (the arrived event lands on a fix timestamp), no trace gap (max_gap_sec 0.0, 34 fixes), no chat defect (4 messages matching the trip record's count, no msg_id gap), no fare defect. The deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-09105, EV-TRIP-09105, EV-CHAT-09105 and EV-FARE-09105, all at weight 1.0, and the driver's counterparty statement is a concession against his own interest that independently supports the location finding. No POL-NS-09 limb fires: confidence is well above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts conflict, the counterparty-dispute counters are both 0, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artifact. The case is decided on the merits rather than escalated, and the fee is refunded rather than held.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
